verdict.rationale: Datadog documents headless programmatic access. Its API authenticates with an API key header, official client libraries are available, and `ddtrace-run` enables instrumentation via environment variables. It also has one CI-specific capability: uploading coverage reports and blocking merges on thresholds. Evidence for running the product broadly inside CI pipelines is thin. Missing for 10: a documented CI CLI or pipeline integration for general automation, end-to-end CI workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
Authenticate to the API with an [API key](/account_management/api-app-keys/#api-keys) using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
Enable Agent Observability by running your application using the `ddtrace-run` command and specifying the required environment variables.
Upload coverage reports to Datadog, visualize coverage data for pull requests, and block merges based on configurable thresholds.
